in_marathi.name: Rudrika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Woman who delights in the Rudra God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rudrika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Woman who delights in the Rudra God (Shiva) In Hindu mythology, Rudra is the god of destruction and the lord of the cremation ground. This name is derived from the word 'Rud' which means roar, and the suffix 'ka' which means 'the one who'. Thus, the name Rudrika signifies a woman who is devoted to Rudra or Lord Shiva.
